title: Phone Cleaner - AI Cleaner
summary: Clean up your phone space with AI powered phone cleaner.
description:
Need a phone cleaner and file manager in one place? Don't worry this app has got you covered.

Storage Cleaner is an app that has:
- Junk cleaner to clear all junk files.
- AI cleaner to clean large files and folders.
- App manager to view and manage large-size installed apps.
- File manager to manage all files and folders.

Junk File Cleaner
Phone cleaner is an advanced cleaner for Android devices to clean phones. The cleaner app can analyze your phone to remove junk, residual files, obsolete APKs, and temporary files. Temporary junk files are created on the device and take up storage space. Storage cleaner works as junk cleaner for Android phones. All junk and temporary files on the device can be scanned with junk cleaner. Users can clear junk files to clean phone memory and storage space.

Delete Duplicate & Free up space
Phone Cleaner app monitors available storage on your device. Quickly assess remaining space and reclaim it by identifying outdated photos from chat apps, eliminating duplicate files, and more. Enjoy the simplicity of optimizing your device's storage and download the app now for a seamless experience.

Clean Up With AI
AI phone cleaner has an impressive AI cleaning feature. Its advanced AI algorithms detect and scan unnecessary data. Data scanned in AI-powered cleaning includes duplicate photos, old screenshots, large files, etc. AI cleaner scans and lists all the data in front of users that can be cleaned. Users can easily select and delete duplicate images and other unnecessary data with just a few taps.

Application control
The app management tool scans and lists all the applications installed on the device. Manage all your apps efficiently and find large apps easily. Users can also see the space all apps occupy on the phone.

File Manager
Save time searching for photos, videos, and documents on your phone. AI phone cleaner helps users find all kinds of files. The phone manager organizes all the files in their corresponding folders. Users can easily browse through all file categories in the phone cleaner.
